title: ArtifactIngestFinalizeCommand
description: Platform-internal command consumed only by the Artifact Ledger transaction; it is never a Provider or public API capability.
x-semantic-constraints: command_digest is RFC 8785 JCS SHA-256 over the command excluding command_digest
the Platform transaction locks ready_to_finalize, verifies upload and scan digests, creates one immutable ArtifactVersion, advances state and appends Outbox events atomically
Provider, scanner, client and Credential Gateway identities cannot invoke or mint this command
